input: Repaint and seal the garden fence before rain

gold.taskTitle: Repaint and seal the garden fence before rain
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to repaint and seal their garden fence in time before the next rainfall.

questions.title: What material is your fence made of?
questions.description: Knowing whether the fence is wood, metal, vinyl, or composite determines the correct paint and sealant products to use.

questions.title: How many days until rain is forecast?
questions.description: Understanding the available time window helps set a realistic deadline and schedule each step accordingly.

questions.title: What is the approximate length of the fence?
questions.description: The total surface area determines how much paint and sealant to purchase and how long the job will take.

questions.title: Is the fence currently painted, stained, or bare?
questions.description: The existing surface condition affects whether stripping, sanding, or priming is needed before applying new paint.

questions.title: Do you already have paint, sealant, and tools?
questions.description: Knowing what supplies are on hand identifies what still needs to be bought or borrowed before work can begin.

questions.title: Are you doing this alone or with help?
questions.description: The number of people available affects how the work is divided and how long the full job will realistically take.

questions.title: What color or finish do you want on the fence?
questions.description: The desired color and finish type guides product selection and may require a specific number of coats.
